title.narrative: Enhanced access to health services and water quality monitoring in at-risk areas with low coverage

description.narrative: ltpgtltbrgtIn line with the allocation strategy to respond to identified needs, under this project, WHO will implement the following:ltbrgt ltbrgtUnder the Health sector:ltbrgt- Enhance access to health services by contracting one NGO in the Deir Ez Zor governate to provide a package of essential health services in an area suffering from low health coverage.ltbrgt- Provide medication to Al Tamayoz NGO in Rural Damascus to complement current care provided through under other sources, in light of the skyrocketing prices of medicines and pharmaceuticals. This area has been prioritized as the impoverished population cannot afford basic services. ltbrgt- Ensure the reactivation of referral capacity to specialized health care for patients in northeast Syria through either NGO contract (most likely) or direct contract with a health facility pending results of request for proposal (RFP) process. ltbrgt- Conduct a Community Health Assessment across Syria, coordinating with MoH and other health sector partners, to inform a cohesive response and enable prioritization of areas most vulnerable and in need. ltbrgtltbrgtlt/pgtltpgtUnder the WASH sector: ltbrgt- Collect and test water samples from different sources in target areas identified as potential risks for the spread of waterborne diseases. This will involve:ltbrgta) procuring and providing laboratory equipment, reagents, and other water quality testing supplies to local authorities to support ongoing activities of water quality monitoring teams and/or rapid response teams.ltbrgtb) covering the operational costs needed to deploy four teams to conduct water quality monitoring in 27 at-risk subdistricts across five governorates: Rural Damascus, Deir ez Zor, Al Hassakeh, Raqqa, and Aleppo.ltbrgtc) provision of training and on-the-job orientation for teams and supervisors to learn and/or refresh them on conducting water testing and monitoring.ltbrgt- Implement localized response actions to address identified water contamination, minimize contamination of water sources, and improve access to safe drinking water by providing water purification tablets to purify contaminated resources. This will include distributing water purification tablets and raising awareness about safe water practices. ltbrgtlt/pgt
